item.title: Sora o Tobu, 3tsu no Houhou.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: La’cryma
  • 発売日: 2008-07-25
  • スコア: 7.05/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 空を飛ぶ、3つの方法。
  • 英語名: Sora o Tobu, 3tsu no Houhou.

别名

  • Soramitsu

あらすじ

“Can you fly?

Can I fly?

How do you fly?”

Kakeru is an ordinary high school student. One day, he was going to school as usual, but as he got there he saw lots of toy soldiers storming the building. He is lead to a classroom with some other students, still baffled at what was going on.
